name: ladrillosjs
description: A lightweight, zero-dependency web component framework for building modular web applications.

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build --config vite.npm.config.ts
scripts.dev:cdn: concurrently -n build,cdn,sample -c auto "npm run watch:cdn" "npm run serve:cdn" "npm run serve:cdn-sample"
scripts.dev:repl: concurrently -n build,sample -c auto "npm run watch:cdn" "npm run serve:repl"
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build && concurrently -n lib,demo -c auto "npm run dev" "npm --prefix samples/ladrillos-demo run dev"
scripts.dev:site: npm run build && concurrently -n lib,site -c auto "npm run dev" "npm --prefix samples/vite-basic-site run dev"
scripts.dev:vite: npm run build && concurrently -n lib,vite -c auto "npm run dev" "npm --prefix samples/vite-sample run dev"
scripts.dev:dotnet: concurrently "npm run dev:cdn" "cd samples/dotnet-sample && dotnet watch run"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:cdn && npm run verify:build
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:cdn && npm run verify:build && npm run test

author: Daniel Rubio
